capabilities: toggle capture-hiding for all Obsidian windows via a ribbon icon
protect popped-out windows using the window-open workspace event
persist the on/off toggle state across restarts
restore normal capture when the plugin is disabled or unloaded
extras: Windows-only; the ribbon button is a no-op on other platforms. Includes a verification procedure using Win+Shift+S (Snipping Tool). Manual installation only.
problem: Obsidian windows are captured by screen-sharing and recording tools, exposing note contents to viewers of a shared screen.
summary: Windows-only plugin that toggles exclusion of all Obsidian windows from screen sharing and recording via SetWindowDisplayAffinity.
